name: WebAIM
summary: Accessibility resource since 1999: articles, WCAG checklists, evaluation tools and research, plus paid training.
description: WebAIM (Web Accessibility In Mind) is a non-profit service center at Utah State University that has provided web accessibility solutions since 1999. It publishes articles such as Introduction to Web Accessibility, the WCAG 2 and Section 508 checklists, quick references and cheat sheets, and runs the WAVE evaluation tool, the Color Contrast Checker, the WebAIM Million report on the top million home pages and the Screen Reader User Survey; training and consulting are paid services.
contains: articles including Introduction to Web Accessibility
Color Contrast Checker and color-reliant link contrast checker
WebAIM Million automated analysis of the top 1,000,000 home pages
training workshops from $200/person and consulting services
